meta.title: About | Guilherme Reis
meta.description: Guilherme Reis's path between product and engineering — from a curiosity for building things to a Software Engineer shipping SaaS in production.

paragraphs: I started coding because I liked building things. Over time I realized writing code was only part of the job.
Today I mostly enjoy taking a problem that's still a bit messy, figuring out what actually matters, and turning it into a product people can use.

That means moving between product and engineering: understanding what actually solves the problem, deciding how to structure the system, and staying with it until the software reaches production — not just shipping a feature and moving on.

items.title: Understand before building
items.description: I'd rather understand the problem and the context of who's going to use it before settling on the technical solution.

items.title: A foundation that can grow
items.description: Architecture, domain modeling, and technical decisions built so the product can evolve without turning into technical debt.

items.title: Production is the bar
items.description: Code that never reaches production hasn't solved anything. I measure, iterate, and stay close to what actually happens after deploy.
